import React from 'react'; import './AnalysisPanel.css'; const expressionEmoji = { happy: '😊', sad: '😢', angry: '😠', fearful: '😨', disgusted: '🤢', surprised: '😮', neutral: '😐' }; const AnalysisPanel = ({ detections }) => { return (

Analysis Results

{detections.length} face{detections.length > 1 ? 's' : ''}
{detections.map((face) => (
{expressionEmoji[face.expression] || '😐'}
Face #{face.id} {face.confidence}% confidence
Age ~{face.age} yrs
Gender {face.gender}
{face.genderProbability}%
Expression {face.expression}
{face.expressionScore}%
))}
); }; export default AnalysisPanel;
